What is the minor of $c_{22}$ in the matrix
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/c77d5cfdf30eee993e935fb6111221a78425243388519accfdf2d7a7f13d8538.svg)
question.worked_solution:
First, we remove the second row and second column: 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14273095/assets/003d10f08b9476296c8bc4c36076af9f36e5d8581dae59dcd024117401fb5485.svg)

Next, we calculate the determinant:

$$
\begin{aligned}det[\begin{aligned}7x & -3y \\ -y & 5\end{aligned}] & =|\begin{aligned}7x & -3y \\ -y & 5\end{aligned}| \\  & =7x\cdot 5-(-3y)\cdot (-y) \\  & =35x-3{y}^{2}\end{aligned}
$$
